title: Free JuCo Basketball: Cerritos vs. Folsom Lake
description: Skip the $200 pro tickets and catch genuine basketball at Cerritos College Falcon Stadium. Cerritos vs. Folsom Lake is free and delivers real energy.

title: Free JuCo Volleyball: LA Mission vs. Santa Monica
description: Want competitive volleyball without spending a dime? LA Mission takes on Santa Monica at LA Mission College Athletic Complex. Free admission — just show up.

title: Women's Swimming & diving: Pomona-Pitzer vs. Claremont-Mudd-Scripps Colleges
description: Pomona-Pitzer takes on Claremont-Mudd-Scripps Colleges in women's swimming & diving at Pomona-Pitzer Athletics Complex. Competitive, fast-paced, and completely free.

title: Freeway Faceoff: Kings vs. Ducks
description: Freeway Faceoff — need we say more? Crypto.com Arena will be rocking when the Ducks roll in. Don't miss this one.

title: Rams vs. Kansas City Chiefs
description: The Kansas City Chiefs come to town for a Friday clash at SoFi Stadium. The Rams are looking to put on a show for the home crowd.

title: Crosstown Showdown: UCLA vs. USC Trojans
description: One of the best rivalries in football is back. The USC Trojans visit Rose Bowl Stadium with bragging rights on the line.
